verdict.rationale: RevenueCat is a subscription and billing platform, so invoicing is a fair axis to ask about. Its Web SDK works with RevenueCat Billing. However, the evidence pack never documents invoice or credit-note generation, sequential numbering, custom fields, memos, or automatic delivery of documents to customers. The only 'receipts' mentioned are Apple receipts imported via the POST /receipts API during migration, which is an unrelated capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform generates compliant invoices, credit notes, and receipts — sequential numbering, custom fields, memos — delivered to customers automatically
